name: Intense Fight in the Destroyed Sky

releases.name: Intense Fight in the Destroyed Sky

description.text: The last expansion of the DP series, released on 10 July 2008 and tied to the film Giratina and the Sky Warrior. Shaymin made its card debut here, with Shaymin LV.X, alongside attacks that only Giratina has and Trainers whose effect changes when two are played together. From this set on, shiny Pokémon appeared as holo cards, and earlier Pokémon came back in other types. Its last three cards reprint Charmander, Charmeleon and Charizard from the first expansion pack of twelve years before. The cards are numbered to 92. In English it became Stormfront in November 2008, except Shaymin, whose cards came out in Platinum in February 2009 instead.
